title: SolidBit Bounded Human Action Gate Approval Specification v1
description: Generic bounded approval token for SACL V1. Bound strictly to request_id, job_id, action, scope, and expiration. Resumes the same logical run and cannot override hard local policy denials.

request_id.description: Unique identifier of the authorization request being decided.

job_id.description: Logical job identifier bound to the approval.

run_id.description: Specific logical run identifier resumed by this approval.

action.description: The specific bounded action authorized (e.g. STAGE_CONTINUATION, BRANCH_INTEGRATION, SPECIFICATION_MATERIALIZATION).

scope.description: Bounded operational or path scope permitted for the action.

identity.description: Identity of the sovereign human approver (e.g. Joaquín).

channel.description: Channel through which approval was attested.

resume_run.description: Indicates that this approval resumes the existing paused logical run rather than starting a new run.

cannot_override_hard_deny.description: Constitutional invariant: approvals cannot override hard local policy denies.
